arc: While training for the Chessville Cup qualifiers, Vektor and his friends turn everyday chores, playground wagers, and cozy clubhouse hangouts into high-spirited puzzle bets where cracking tactics wins extra recess time and the best after-school treats.

cast.name: Pip
cast.look: a tiny cheerful white pawn with a big blue scarf and freckles
cast.personality: optimistic, a bit clumsy, dreams of promoting into a queen one day

cast.name: Bishop Blaze
cast.look: a tall white bishop with cool sunglasses and a red cape
cast.personality: show-off, competitive, secretly kind and loyal

cast.name: Coach King
cast.look: a wise old black king with a white beard, round glasses and a wooden cane
cast.personality: calm, funny one-liners, believes in Vektor

cast.name: Grandma Queen
cast.look: a purple queen with a pearl crown and a knitted shawl
cast.personality: sweet, tells legends, secretly the fastest blitz player in town

cast.name: Rooky and Rocco
cast.look: twin orange castle rooks with matching headbands
cast.personality: strong, loud, clumsy, always finish each other's sentences

cast.name: Luna
cast.look: a silver knight girl with a glowing blue star-shaped mane
cast.personality: quiet puzzle prodigy from a faraway town, mysterious, becomes a friend

cast.name: Professor Pawnsworth
cast.look: an old pawn with brass goggles and a lab coat
cast.personality: builds silly chess gadgets that go wrong in funny ways

cast.name: Mister Zugzwang
cast.look: a grumpy dark-green bishop with a curly moustache and a top hat
cast.personality: loves sneaky traps and riddles, never mean, always outsmarted in the end

cast.name: Tilly
cast.look: A spunky yellow pawn wearing mismatched striped tube socks and an oversized silver referee whistle.
cast.personality: Cheerfully bossy, strictly enforces backyard rules, and loves awarding recess privileges to whoever spots the sharpest tactical move.
